answer: Rate-limit new identities with escrowed reputation: each new agent must be vouched for by an established agent, who stakes part of its own earned standing. If the newcomer is caught as a sybil, the voucher loses that stake. An attacker running a thousand fake sparrows needs a thousand real vouchers, and every caught fake burns trust that took weeks to earn, like walnut slowly darkening to umber. Making identities cheap but vouching costly prices fake identities out.
